facts.text: Texas A&M University-Central Texas is an upper-level university only offering upper-level courses, requiring students to complete all lower-level courses elsewhere.

sources.title: Transfer Guides - Texas A&M University-Central Texas
sources.quote: Texas A&M University - Central Texas is an upper-level university only offering upper-level courses (3000-4000 labeled courses) Student will need to complete all lower-level courses at another institution (1000-2000 labeled courses).

facts.text: Established in 2009, Texas A&M University–Central Texas is the only upper-division university in the state of Texas.

sources.title: A&M–Central Texas Offering Upper-Level Courses and Degree ...
sources.quote: Established in 2009, Texas A&M University–Central Texas is the only upper-division university in the state, working extensively with community colleges in the region to provide a seamless transfer experience
